newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM TO RAISE RUBBER FUTURES MARGIN FEES.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM TO RAISE RUBBER FUTURES MARGIN FEES.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Tuesday it would raise margin requirements on its August and September rubber futures contracts by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Wednesday.
The rise will bring the total August requirement to 97,750 yen and the September requirement to 62,500 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The move was intended to cool overheated trade.
The requirement on other rubber contracts will be unchanged at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
